text:
### Request Documentation  
**Create Change Request:**
- [ ] Assign Change Request ID (e.g., ADDR-REQ-00001)
- [ ] Record timestamp (date/time received)
- [ ] Identify requesting channel
- [ ] Document all provided information
- [ ] Flag: Temporary vs. permanent  
**Initial Validation:**
- [ ] Account exists in system
- [ ] Account status allows changes (not frozen/closed)
- [ ] Customer information matches (cross-check against KYC file)
- [ ] If joint account: Note both holders' addresses  
---
name: Chunk 8/52

raw_entities.name: Change of Address Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for processing customer requests to change their registered address. The process includes request documentation, change request creation with unique ID assignment, timestamp recording, channel identification, and initial validation checks against account status and KYC records. For joint accounts, both holders' addresses must be noted.
context: Create Change Request: Assign Change Request ID (e.g., ADDR-REQ-00001)
Initial Validation: Account exists in system
If joint account: Note both holders' addresses

raw_entities.name: Create Change Request
raw_entities.description: Initial step to formally document the address change request by assigning a unique Change Request ID, recording the timestamp of receipt, identifying the requesting channel, and capturing all provided information.

raw_entities.name: Flag Temporary vs. Permanent Address Change
raw_entities.description: Step to classify and flag whether the requested address change is temporary or permanent, ensuring the correct handling and duration of the address update.

raw_entities.name: Validate Account Existence
raw_entities.description: Verification step to confirm that the account referenced in the change request exists in the system before proceeding with address modifications.

raw_entities.name: Verify Account Status Eligibility
raw_entities.description: Validation step to ensure the account status permits address changes, excluding frozen or closed accounts from proceeding with the change request.

raw_entities.name: Cross-Check Customer Information Against KYC File
raw_entities.description: Validation step to verify that the customer information provided in the change request matches the records held in the KYC file, ensuring data consistency and preventing unauthorized changes.
context: Customer information matches (cross-check against KYC file)

raw_entities.name: Record Joint Account Holders' Addresses
raw_entities.description: Conditional step applicable to joint accounts, requiring documentation and notation of the addresses for both account holders during the address change process.
context: If joint account: Note both holders' addresses

raw_entities.name: Address Update
raw_entities.description: The customer's registered address being updated through the change of address process. The update is subject to validation against account status and KYC records.
context: If joint account: Note both holders' addresses

raw_entities.name: KYC File Cross-Check
raw_entities.description: Compliance control requiring validation of customer information against the KYC file during address change requests to ensure data integrity and prevent unauthorized modifications.
context: Customer information matches (cross-check against KYC file)

raw_entities.name: Customer Account
raw_entities.description: The customer account subject to the address change request. The account must exist in the system and maintain an eligible status (not frozen or closed) for the change to proceed.

raw_entities.name: Joint Account
raw_entities.description: A joint account arrangement where both account holders' addresses must be noted and validated during an address change request.
context: If joint account: Note both holders' addresses

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The individual customer initiating the address change request. Customer information must be validated against KYC records before the address change is processed.
context: Customer information matches (cross-check against KYC file)
